summary: Public projects created on 21 October 2026: 10 repos, 2 datasets and 4 models.
intro: Claude Code plugins for Bluetooth control on Linux, temporary network overflow, spam filtering, Maccabi Online skills, and a marketplace guide. Small text models handle paragraph breaks in speech-to-text output, bolding key lines in dictated emails, and swapping identifying details for substitutes.

projects.name: ASR Paragraph Breaks
projects.description: Hand-annotated paragraph breaks for flat ASR text, and a small text-in/text-out model trained on them

projects.name: Claude Agent Exchange
projects.description: A two-way file exchange between you and Claude Code: from-human / from-agent folders, a CLAUDE.md block, and a small explorer app locked to them

projects.name: Claude Linux BT Plugin
projects.description: Claude Code plugin: Bluetooth on Linux via bluetoothctl — scan, pair+trust+connect, manage, reset. Because the desktop dialogs don't.

projects.name: Claude Marketplace Guide Plugin
projects.description: Start here for the danielrosehill Claude Code marketplace: browse plugins by theme, get recommendations, see what's new — read live from the manifest

projects.name: Claude Network Tmp Plugin
projects.description: Claude Code plugin: capped, self-cleaning network overflow for a small or tmpfs /tmp

projects.name: Claude Pseudospam Filter Plugin
projects.description: Claude Code plugin: a second spam filter for pseudo-personalised outreach, taught by your own Gmail labels

projects.name: Gemma 3 270M Email Key Line Bolding
projects.description: Gemma 3 270M fine-tune that bolds the key lines of a dictated email and changes nothing else

projects.name: Maccabi Online Skills
projects.description: Unofficial Claude Code skills for Maccabi Online, the Maccabi Healthcare Services (Israel) member portal — drives your own signed-in Chrome

projects.name: Proximate Pseudonymizer
projects.description: Small text-in/text-out model that swaps identifying details for proximate, consistent substitutes

projects.name: To Skill Or Not To Skill
projects.description: Before any task, ask: should this become a skill? A user-level heuristic for AI agents, as a Claude Code plugin plus a CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md installer.

projects.name: ASR Paragraph Breaks
projects.description: Hand-annotated paragraph breaks for flat speech-to-text output. ASR engines emit punctuated, cased text as one block.

projects.name: Email Key Line Bolding
projects.description: Hand annotations of which words in a dictated email should be bold: any run of whole words within a paragraph, from a phrase to several sentences.

projects.name: Gemma 3 270M ASR Paragraph Breaks
projects.description: Adds paragraph breaks to flat speech-to-text output and changes nothing else.

projects.name: Gemma 3 270M ASR Paragraph Breaks ONNX
projects.description: ONNX export of danielrosehill/Gemma-3-270M-ASR-Paragraph-Breaks for ONNX Runtime, so it can run on a phone on the same runtime as an ONNX speech-recognition model.

projects.name: Gemma 3 270M Email Key Line Bolding
projects.description: Puts the key parts of a dictated email in Markdown bold, and changes nothing else.
